comment: Just writes things on the board and expects you to know them. You get one problem per class to understand an entire chapter or concept. Not a soul talking besides him. Corporate Finance is a hard class but is even worse with Arnold.

No textbook, no supplementary material, just copying his hand-written notes off of a whiteboard. If you miss a day, its over. Would spend hours decoding how he completed his problems after class, as his formulas and methods can't be found online. Studying for these exams were literal hell, just scraping your brain to hopefully remember something.

This class is all on you, you have to study 2-3 hours a day from the first day of the semester till the end if you want an A. He teaches like we all have experience in the real world and does not explain well in class. The text book is your best friend for this class, otherwise, good luck.

Professor Arnold is a nice guy but really has no connection to his students. Excel is only used for homeworks as he turns his back and writes on the whiteboard for the entire class. I feel Excel should be used to improve efficiency of learning and providing students tools to use in the real world.
Beware.

Do not take this class. Tests are 90% of your grade (most of the class is failing). Several students withdrew because there is legit no way to bring up your grade. We get 30's and 50's on these exams (and I haven't gotten below a B in college and am putting a lot of work into this class). No textbook or class resources.

This class is mostly memorization of a large amount of relatively simple equations. Almost none of the material covered in class is posted online. Tests are without a formula sheet and make up 90% of the grade. Tests are very manageable as long as you are able to memorize all the formulas and a few concepts.

I'd definitely recommend him for 360, he first comes off as strict and serious, but he's actually is pretty laid back. Exams are really easy, just memorize all of the formulas which can be a lot. Do the practice tests and you'll be fine, take good notes too. Almost no hw either and he lets you out 15-30 min early almost every class.

Prof. Arnold is a super smart dude, but when it comes to teaching its not his area of expertise. He just writes formulas on the board barely explaining how they apply to anything and its up to you to try to figure it out when youre doing the homework. Tests arent bad but you need to memorize 80+ formulas for the exams. Try to take someone else.

Dr. Arnold gives very clear-cut and straightforward lectures. Sometimes it can feel like a lot, but you have to put in the work outside of class in order to do well. You have a few homeworks and 3 tests that make up your entire grade, one of which is an optional final exam. He is really laid back and knows what he's doing.

Professor Arnold really rewards effort throughout the semester by letting you not take finals which was a life saviour. Be careful if you registered for the class based on others' recs prior to COVID. Everything is on Excel and he doesn't release practice tests. Exercises should be enough for the computation test but MC is pretty much random.

2021 COVID Spring Prof. Arnold is great! The chapters are brief and clear. Rewards consistency: gives an option to not take final and take grade earned up until then. His exam questions are in your notes. Write everything on the board including relevant things he says but doesn't write. They're the key to the tricky exam questions. Dry Humor King

Don't take Arnold's class in COVID-19. He changed his test format drastically and doesn't release any practice questions for exams so you can't have any preparation going in. Minimal participation. Not really my style.

Tom Arnold is a real gem. His tests are super straightforward and everything on the tests are in your notes... no surprises which is really nice. He is actually really funny if you listen for his dry humored jokes. Tests are 90% of your grade though so definitely study hard. There are 4 pretty easy homework assignments that make up the other 10%.

I am not a finance major but took Arnold for my FIN360 requirement. I'm glad I did. While I don't know anyone who will get an A in his class, he is extremely fair and the things I have learned, I truly understand and have retained. You should know that 90% of your grade is determined by tests, so if you're not a good test-taker, pass on him!

No participation needed. There are 4 hw assignments for the entire semester and they are not very hard. Three tests including the final (not cumulative). Lectures are boring and he is not super helpful outside of class if you don't understand something, but people rarely need help because the class is pretty straight-forward. Good guy/teacher.
I really appreciate professors like Arnold who are fair. Thank god.

Really good professor. You don't need the book and it's probably for the better. You only learn what you actually need to and he is extremely clear. Does a great job of explaining concepts and would never throw a curve ball on a test or homework assignment (only 3 assignments). Definitely recommend. If you do  the work, you will get an A

Arnold is a really nice guy and is very helpful if you go in for questions.  The tests require you to know tons of material so you can't cram the night before, but everything is straight out of the notes.  Study hard and you should do fine!

Arnold is the man.  Super clear, easy to follow and very fair.  It was hard not to do well in his class but if you slack off / do not read you will get crushed.  He is picky for perfect papers and details but A's and B's aren't hard to come by.
Best teacher ever!

The King?  I mean Arnie the KING?? YEAAA MEAN YEA hes a big ol' sweetie of a nerd.  Bout 6-8 and built for destruction,and he couldnt be more attentive to detail on the white board...talkin he writes perfect cursive.  Good news is you can just copy notes braindead in class, and he makes some funny cracks ev now and then. Few testsand hws, great guy
Great guy, tests were very straightfoward, never any tricks.  Very helpful outside of class, really liked the subject coming out of it.  Definitely would take him again.

Breaks down the material into easy, manageable notes.  Very knowledgeable and easy to approach with questions.  Tests take a lot of studying but are based straight from the notes.  Easy going guy, easy to get along with and learn from.  One of the best prof's in the b-school.
Ok so dreading the subject going in.  Loved it coming out.  He made what would be a difficult class, so fun to come to and enjoy early in the morning.  Definately the best prof in the B-school!
He teaches so well, I haven't opened the book and gotten a 100 on nearly everything.
No Comments
No Comments

Extremely straight-edge guy who seems like he will be extremely boring for the entire semester. notes are so clear u can miss class and get the notes from a classmate and still know what's going on. Wont know your name, but helpful out of class.
